researcher_notes: 2014 = year Novatek initiated the Arctic LNG 1 project: the OOO Arctic LNG 1 subsidiary was established and received the Russian Government LNG export right in October 2014 (Seligman/LinkedIn). EN Wikipedia opens 'Arctic LNG1 is a project initiated in 2014' but that specific claim is uncited and likely echoes the same Seligman source, so this is effectively single-origin -> tier low, independent false. Caveat/conflict: the project gained its high-profile public profile in 2019 (core Soletsko-Khanaveyskoye resource base acquired Aug 2019; positioned as Novatek's 'next' project alongside the Arctic LNG 2 FID), so a reviewer could prefer 2019 as the formal 'announced' year; 2014 chosen here as the earliest documented public inception. FID still not taken as of 2026.

No Final Investment Decision has been taken on Arctic LNG 3 (substatus 'planned' = a future, not-yet-occurred FID). Russian/industry coverage states investment decisions on Arctic LNG-3 (and Arctic LNG-1, Murmansk LNG) have not yet been adopted; construction is forecast no earlier than 2030 and an FID only in the late 2020s, but no firm/scheduled FID year is publicly announced. A single citable FID year cannot be pinned -> UNRESOLVED (no fabricated year).

Aurora SPG Spassk-Dalny small-tonnage LNG complex (Aurora LNG group; two production lines, 32,000 t/y, RUB 3.3 bn, Free Port of Vladivostok resident) was publicly announced / launched in May 2025 -> proposed year 2025. Confirmed by the Russian Far East ministry press service (dfo.gov.ru, government primary), eastrussia.ru and mashnews.ru (three independent Russian-language write-ups). Train 1 is one of the plant's two production lines, proposed 2025.

Same project/announcement as Train 1: Aurora SPG Spassk-Dalny LNG complex publicly announced/launched May 2025 (two production lines; Free Port of Vladivostok resident), confirmed by dfo.gov.ru (government), eastrussia.ru and mashnews.ru. Train 2 is the plant's second production line, proposed 2025.

Rosneft / ExxonMobil Far East LNG plant (De-Kastri, Khabarovsk Krai; gas from Sakhalin-1) was unveiled/launched in 2013. JPT/SPE: 'In 2013, Rosneft and Exxon had unveiled their plan to build a joint LNG production site in Russia's Far East region'; IENE (2017): 'Rosneft launched the project in 2013.' Two independent publishers, both verified. T1 is the first train, proposed 2013.

Same project/proposal as T1: Rosneft/ExxonMobil Far East LNG (De-Kastri) plan unveiled/launched in 2013 (JPT: 'In 2013, Rosneft and Exxon had unveiled their plan'; IENE: 'Rosneft launched the project in 2013'). Two independent publishers. T2 is the second train, proposed 2013.

Gorskaya FLNG (LNG-Gorskaya, near St Petersburg) was never formally cancelled/terminated by any announcement. Last concrete activity was 2017 (USC LNG-bunker-vessel order, Baltic bunkering agreements, Kinlan financing deal); the original planned Dec 2016 start was never met and the project has been dormant since. GEM's substatus 'inferred 4 y' implies cancellation inferred from ~4 years' dormancy (which would point to ~2021 from 2017 + 4y), but that is an inference, not a sourceable date -- no source states a cancellation year, so UNRESOLVED (no fabricated/inferred year staged).

Same as Gorskaya T1: project never formally cancelled; last activity 2017; dormant since; no source declares a cancellation year. 'inferred 4 y' is GEM's dormancy inference (~2021 implied), not a citable date -> UNRESOLVED.

Same as Gorskaya T1/T2: project never formally cancelled; last activity 2017; dormant since; no source declares a cancellation year. 'inferred 4 y' is GEM's dormancy inference, not a citable date -> UNRESOLVED.

Kara LNG (Rosneft; proposed export terminal on Novaya Zemlya, ~30 Mtpa, Kara Sea gas) is an early-stage pre-FID project. Coverage puts a possible online date at 2030-2035; the project was last mentioned ~Oct 2023 and was omitted from Russia's Energy Strategy to 2050 (April 2025). No Final Investment Decision has been taken or scheduled to a specific year (substatus 'planned' = future FID), so an FID year cannot be pinned -> UNRESOLVED.
